results.title: Kick streamer Neon reacts to viral GTA 6 character resembling him after Rockstar’s Netflix showcase
results.description: The recent gameplay reveal for GTA 6 has sparked considerable buzz online, especially among gaming enthusiasts. A side mission featured a character reminiscent of Kick streamer Neon, who shared his thrill at possibly inspiring the game's development. During a subsequent livestream, he even recreated the now-famous scene, showcasing how GTA 6 is weaving in contemporary internet phenomena into its narrative.
